title: Neural Networks
description: Understanding representation, depth, and learning from first principles.

content.text: A neural network is a composition of simple transformations. Its power comes from arranging them so useful features can be built from other features.
A layer takes a representation and gives it another shape. Non-linearity keeps the composition from collapsing into one linear operation.

def forward(x, weight, bias):
    return relu(x @ weight + bias)

content.title: Useful lens
content.text: Think of depth as a sequence of coordinate systems, each making a different regularity easier to express.
